verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents an official CLI on its docs site. The docs say it can be used from a terminal "or through an automated system" to run API tests, automate monitoring and manage collections. The `hopp test` command also generates JUnit reports for collection runs, and a probe confirmed the CLI documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and explicit AI/agent-oriented CLI affordances (e.g. machine-readable output designed for agents) beyond generic automation.
